content:
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Fold are just a few weeks away from launch, with Apple conducting intensive preparations internally. According to Bloomberg, Apple will hold a lottery for its U.S. retail employees, with winners being sent to California to assist with the September iPhone launch event.

The iPhone launch event is tentatively scheduled for September.

The report states that retail employees at Apple Stores can apply to participate in the iPhone launch event, where they will be responsible for "assisting with queue arrangements, registering attendees, greeting guests, providing directions, and supporting the security team."

Apple announced the lottery arrangement in an internal memo today, stating that the event will be held in early September.

The memo mentioned that Apple is "very honored to offer U.S. store team members the opportunity to participate in the event support experience programme." For many years, Apple has relied on retail employees to help coordinate major product launches. The memo also noted that employees who participated in this year's Worldwide Developers Conference or last year's iPhone launch event will not be eligible to apply for this programme. Interested employees must submit their applications by August 8, and Apple will notify successful applicants on August 17.

Apple has traditionally held its annual iPhone launch event in the second week of September. With U.S. Labor Day falling on September 7 this year, Bloomberg therefore believes there is a "higher chance the event will be held on a Wednesday, as this preserves the weekday travel time Apple has historically provided for attendees."

If this is the case, the iPhone launch event will be held on Wednesday, September 9, with pre-orders expected to open that Friday and the product officially going on sale a week later.
